## TechCrunch (5)

### `techcrunch_article`

- **HTTP:** `GET /techcrunch/article`
- **What:** Get TechCrunch article content. Returns public TechCrunch article metadata (title, author(s), published/updated dates, dek, section, lead image) and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL.

### `techcrunch_author`

- **HTTP:** `GET /techcrunch/author`
- **What:** Get a TechCrunch author profile. Returns one TechCrunch staff writer or contributor's public profile: name, job title, headshot, biography, social links, and one page of their recent articles.
- **Params:** `page` (integer, optional) — 1-based page of recent articles to return; defaults to 1; `url` (string, **required**) — Canonical techcrunch.com/author/<slug> URL

### `techcrunch_headlines`

- **HTTP:** `GET /techcrunch/headlines`
- **What:** Get TechCrunch category headlines. Returns the latest TechCrunch stories for one category. `section` is required and takes one of 22 slugs such as `artificial-intelligence`, `startups`, `venture`, `security`, `fintech`, `space` or `cryptocurrency`. Each item has its title, URL, summary, publication time and author.

### `techcrunch_news`

- **HTTP:** `GET /techcrunch/news`
- **What:** Get TechCrunch top stories. Returns the latest TechCrunch top stories from its home feed. Takes no parameters. Each item has its title, URL, summary, publication time and author name.

### `techcrunch_sections`

- **HTTP:** `GET /techcrunch/sections`
- **What:** Get TechCrunch categories. Lists the 22 TechCrunch categories that `techcrunch-headlines` accepts, taken from the site's primary navigation dropdown. Each entry has a stable `slug`, a display `name` and the category's feed `url`. For example, `artificial-intelligence` is named AI.

## TechRadar (5)

### `techradar_article`

- **What:** Get TechRadar article content. Returns a TechRadar article by canonical `url` on `techradar.com`: title, description, section, authors, publication and update times, lead image, the body `paragraphs` and a `paywalled` flag.

### `techradar_author`

- **HTTP:** `GET /techradar/author`
- **What:** Get a TechRadar author profile. Returns a TechRadar author's profile, looked up by `slug` (for example `tom-power`) or canonical `url`, which may end in `/page/<n>`; exactly one is required. `page` (1-based, default 1) overrides any page in `url`. The response has the name, `job_title`, biography, social links, one page of articles and `has_next_page`.
- **Params:** `page` (integer, optional) — 1-based page number; overrides any page number in url; `slug` (string, optional) — Author slug, e.g. tom-power; `url` (string, optional) — Canonical techradar.com/author/<slug> URL, optionally with a /page/<n> segment; alternative to slug

### `techradar_headlines`

Each item has its title, URL, summary, publication time, author and image.

### `techradar_news`

### `techradar_sections`

## Tes (7)

### `tes_job_detail`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tes/jobs/detail`
- **What:** Get a Tes teaching job. Returns detail for one job posting by its numeric id (the id field returned by tes-job-search): employer, location, salary, contract terms/types, dates, and application contact/URL, plus a short excerpt of the listing description rather than the full long-form HTML copy.
- **Params:** `id` (string, **required**) — Tes job id

### `tes_job_employer`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tes/jobs/employer`
- **What:** Get a Tes jobs employer profile. Returns detail for one jobs employer profile by its numeric id (the trailing id in tes-job-detail's employer_url field, e.g. .../jobs/employer/epsom-college-1039424 -- the 1039424): name, location, school type/phase/funding status/gender/age range, an about description, its postal address, and every currently-open position listed on the employer's own profile page (id, title, url -- call tes-job-detail with each id for the full posting).
- **Params:** `id` (string, **required**) — Tes employer id

### `tes_job_search`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tes/jobs/search`
- **What:** Search Tes teaching jobs. Searches Tes's (tes.com) teaching-jobs board. Returns listing facts (title, employer, location, salary, contract terms/types) plus a short excerpt of the listing description, not the full long-form job-description copy, and the same live faceted-search breakdown (position/subject/workplace category trees with counts, plus contract type/term counts) the real search page renders as its filter sidebar. location is a free-text place name (a UK town/city, an international city, or a bare country name) resolved to coordinates; omit for Tes's own default market, "United Kingdom". radius_miles selects the search radius around location. contract_type and contract_term are validated against Tes's own small, closed label sets. position, subject, and workplace are comma-separated filters -- Tes's own category labels are numerous and can change, so read a prior response's own facets.positions[].value (and facets.positions[].children[].value)/facets.subjects[].value/facets.workplaces[].children[].value for the live, current set rather than guessing. salary_min filters to jobs with an advertised salary at or above that amount (in the searched market's local currency); Tes's own filter panel offers only a minimum, no maximum.
- **Params:** `contract_term` (string, optional) — Contract term; `contract_type` (string, optional) — Contract type; `keywords` (string, optional) — Job title or keyword; `location` (string, optional) — Free-text place name resolved via Tes's own location autocomplete; `page` (integer, optional) — One-based page; `page_size` (integer, optional) — Results per page; `position` (string, optional) — Comma-separated position category label(s) -- see the endpoint markdown; `radius_miles` (integer, optional) — Search radius around location, in miles; `salary_min` (integer, optional) — Minimum advertised salary, in the searched market's local currency; `sort` (string, optional) — Sort order; `subject` (string, optional) — Comma-separated subject label(s) -- see the endpoint markdown; `workplace` (string, optional) — Comma-separated workplace/organisation-type label(s) -- see the endpoint markdown

### `tes_resource_detail`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tes/resources/detail`
- **What:** Get a Tes teaching resource. Returns detail for one teaching resource by its numeric id (the id field returned by tes-resource-search). Descriptive facts (title, subject, age range, resource type, author, price, rating, licence label), a per-file attachment list (file type, size, and a preview thumbnail -- metadata only), and the most recent page of reviews are returned -- not the downloadable resource file itself.
- **Params:** `country` (string, optional) — Storefront market for pricing/currency; `id` (string, **required**) — Tes resource id

### `tes_resource_search`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tes/resources/search`
- **What:** Search Tes teaching resources. Searches Tes's (tes.com) teaching-resources marketplace. Returns listing facts (title, author, price, rating, downloads) -- not full listing descriptions. query is optional: omit it (alone, or combined with key_stage/subject/on_sale) for pure filter-driven or fully unfiltered browsing. sort mirrors the real search page's own Sort by dropdown; key_stage and subject mirror its left-hand Refine by filters (both closed, validated enums taken from Tes's own facet taxonomy, and always resolved against Tes's own single GB-taxonomy regardless of country). country controls result currency/localisation only (confirmed live for all seven values); it does not change which key_stage/subject values are valid.
- **Params:** `country` (string, optional) — Storefront market; `key_stage` (string, optional) — Filter by age range; `on_sale` (boolean, optional) — Filter to discounted resources only; `page` (integer, optional) — One-based page; `page_size` (integer, optional) — Results per page; `query` (string, optional) — Search keywords -- omit for filter-driven or unfiltered browsing; `sort` (string, optional) — Sort order; `subject` (string, optional) — Filter by subject -- one of Tes's own top-level subject facet labels; see the endpoint markdown for the full list (two of the 29 values contain a comma, which is why this parameter is not expressed as a Swagger Enums() list)

### `tes_resource_shop`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tes/resources/shop`
- **What:** Get a Tes teaching-resources author shop. Returns detail for one teaching-resources author/seller shop by its username (from tes-resource-search/tes-resource-detail's author field, or the trailing path segment of author_url): display name, average rating, upload/view/download counts, a bio, and a page of that author's resource listing (id, title, price, thumbnail -- call tes-resource-detail with each id for subject/age-range/resource-type/rating/description). subject narrows the listing to one of the subject tabs shown on the shop's own page; these vary per author and are not a curated enum.
- **Params:** `page` (integer, optional) — One-based page; `subject` (string, optional) — Subject tab to filter the listing to -- see the shop's own page for the current set; `username` (string, **required**) — Tes author username

### `tes_school_search`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tes/schools/search`
- **What:** Search the Tes Schools Directory. Searches Tes's (tes.com) public Schools Directory by school name or location. Returns listing facts (name, logo, a short description, address) for each matching school/employer. Each result's id is the same employer id tes-job-employer accepts, so a caller can go straight from a name/location search to a full employer profile (school type/phase/funding status/gender/age range, and its currently-open positions) without first needing a job posting to discover the id.
- **Params:** `page` (integer, optional) — One-based page; `page_size` (integer, optional) — Results per page; `query` (string, **required**) — School name or location

## Tesla Jobs (2)

### `tesla_jobs_job`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tesla-jobs/job`
- **What:** Tesla Jobs single posting. Returns one Tesla Careers posting by its numeric job id (the `id` field returned by the list endpoint).
- **Params:** `id` (string, **required**) — Tesla job id

### `tesla_jobs_list`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tesla-jobs/list`
- **What:** Tesla Jobs listing. Searches Tesla's public careers site (tesla.com/careers) via its own careers-state JSON endpoint. Tesla's own endpoint always returns its entire global job dataset regardless of query parameters; this filters and paginates that snapshot server-side. Listings carry identity/department/location metadata only — call the job endpoint for the full description, responsibilities, and requirements.

## The Age (5)

### `theage_article`

- **HTTP:** `GET /theage/article`
- **What:** Get The Age article content. Returns one The Age article's public metadata and the body paragraphs an anonymous visitor's page request is served, from a canonical article URL. The Age runs a metered subscription paywall; the response reports it with is_accessible_for_free (the page's own declaration), paywalled (the page marks the story as subscriber content), and is_truncated (the page served a shortened preview, or no body at all, instead of the full story). Paywalls are never bypassed and body text is never fabricated. Video-only pages are rejected with a 400.
- **Params:** `url` (string, **required**) — Canonical The Age article URL

### `theage_author`

- **HTTP:** `GET /theage/author`
- **What:** Get an Age journalist profile. Returns an Age journalist's public profile -- name, short biography, headshot, contact email and social links where published -- plus their recent stories, from a canonical https://www.theage.com.au/by/<name>-<id> URL.
- **Params:** `url` (string, **required**) — Canonical The Age journalist URL

### `theage_headlines`

- **HTTP:** `GET /theage/headlines`
- **What:** Get The Age section headlines. Returns the current stories for one The Age section: title, canonical URL, summary, author, publication time, and image where the section lists them. section must be one of the slugs returned by /theage/sections; any other value is rejected with a 400 before The Age is contacted.
- **Params:** `section` (string, **required**) — Section slug from /theage/sections

### `theage_news`

- **HTTP:** `GET /theage/news`
- **What:** Get The Age top stories. Returns The Age's current "Latest News" public RSS feed: each story's title, canonical URL, summary, author, publication time, and lead image.
- **Params:** _none_

### `theage_sections`

- **HTTP:** `GET /theage/sections`
- **What:** Get The Age sections. Lists every The Age section accepted by /theage/headlines (96 sections from the site's own section menu), each with its slug, display name, and public section-front URL.
- **Params:** _none_

## The Atlantic (4)

### `theatlantic_article`

- **HTTP:** `GET /theatlantic/article`
- **What:** Get an Atlantic article's content. Returns one public Atlantic article's metadata and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL. `metered` reflects the site's own soft-paywall flag for that article; the body returned here is the same one the site's own page serves to an anonymous visitor and is never truncated because of it. An article whose page genuinely withholds its body is reported as a restricted-access error instead of a hollow response.
- **Params:** `url` (string, **required**) — Canonical The Atlantic article URL

### `theatlantic_author`

- **HTTP:** `GET /theatlantic/author`
- **What:** Get an Atlantic staff author profile. Returns one Atlantic staff author's public profile -- name, headshot, and biography -- plus their recent articles, from a canonical author URL.
- **Params:** `url` (string, **required**) — Canonical theatlantic.com/author/<slug>/ URL

### `theatlantic_headlines`

- **HTTP:** `GET /theatlantic/headlines`
- **What:** Get the latest stories in an Atlantic section. Returns the current front-page article cards for one Atlantic section: each story's title, canonical URL, description, byline, publication time, and lead image. Section must be a slug returned by /theatlantic/sections.
- **Params:** `section` (string, **required**) — Section slug from /theatlantic/sections

### `theatlantic_sections`

- **HTTP:** `GET /theatlantic/sections`
- **What:** List The Atlantic sections. Lists every top-level Atlantic section accepted by /theatlantic/headlines, with its slug, display name, and landing-page URL. Values: `ideas`, `politics`, `economy`, `international`, `national-security`, `technology`, `science`, `health`, `education`, `culture`, `family`, `books`, `photography`.
- **Params:** _none_

## The Body Shop (11)

### `thebodyshop_collection_products`

- **HTTP:** `GET /thebodyshop/collections/{handle}/products`
- **What:** List The Body Shop collection products. Returns products from one The Body Shop (https://www.thebodyshop.com) collection. The storefront URL is fixed; `handle` is the collection's URL slug.
- **Params:** `handle` (string, **required**) — Collection handle; `limit` (integer, optional) — Maximum products, defaults to 50 and supports up to 250; `page` (integer, optional) — 1-based page, defaults to 1

### `thebodyshop_collections`

- **HTTP:** `GET /thebodyshop/collections`
- **What:** List The Body Shop collections. Returns collections from The Body Shop (https://www.thebodyshop.com). The storefront URL is fixed. Valid empty result pages return `200` with an empty collections array.
- **Params:** `limit` (integer, optional) — Maximum collections, defaults to 50 and supports up to 250; `page` (integer, optional) — 1-based page, defaults to 1

### `thebodyshop_page`

- **HTTP:** `GET /thebodyshop/pages/{handle}`
- **What:** Get a The Body Shop static page. Returns one The Body Shop static page by its `handle`: id, title, URL, plain-text `content` and the created, published and updated timestamps. Page text is cleaned, not raw HTML. An unknown handle returns 404. When the reduced form is served, `transport_mode` is `ssr_embedded` and `id` is omitted.
- **Params:** `handle` (string, **required**) — Page handle

### `thebodyshop_pages`

- **HTTP:** `GET /thebodyshop/pages`
- **What:** List The Body Shop static pages. Lists The Body Shop static pages, 50 per request by default (`limit` up to 250), with `page` starting at 1. Each page has its handle, title, URL, plain-text content and timestamps. An empty result is a normal 200. When `transport_mode` is `ssr_embedded`, items carry only `handle`, `url` and `updated_at`.
- **Params:** `limit` (integer, optional) — Maximum static pages, defaults to 50 and supports up to 250; `page` (integer, optional) — 1-based page, defaults to 1

### `thebodyshop_product`

- **HTTP:** `GET /thebodyshop/products/{handle}`
- **What:** Get a The Body Shop product. Returns product detail for one The Body Shop (https://www.thebodyshop.com) product handle. The storefront URL is fixed server-side; `handle` is the product's URL slug.
- **Params:** `handle` (string, **required**) — Product handle

### `thebodyshop_product_recommendations`

- **HTTP:** `GET /thebodyshop/products/{handle}/recommendations`
- **What:** List The Body Shop product recommendations. Returns recommended products for one The Body Shop (https://www.thebodyshop.com) product handle. The storefront URL is fixed server-side.
- **Params:** `handle` (string, **required**) — Product handle; `intent` (string, optional) — Recommendation intent. Allowed values: related, complementary; `limit` (integer, optional) — Maximum products, defaults to 10 and supports up to 20

### `thebodyshop_products`

- **HTTP:** `GET /thebodyshop/products`
- **What:** List The Body Shop products. Returns products from The Body Shop's (https://www.thebodyshop.com) public product catalog. The storefront URL is fixed server-side. Valid empty result pages return `200` with an empty products array.
- **Params:** `limit` (integer, optional) — Maximum products, defaults to 50 and supports up to 250; `page` (integer, optional) — 1-based page, defaults to 1

### `thebodyshop_search_suggest`

- **HTTP:** `GET /thebodyshop/search/suggest`
- **What:** Get The Body Shop search suggestions. Returns products, collections, and query suggestions from The Body Shop's (https://www.thebodyshop.com) predictive search. The storefront URL is fixed server-side.
- **Params:** `limit` (integer, optional) — Maximum results per type, defaults to 10 and supports up to 20; `q` (string, **required**) — Search query; `types` (string, optional) — Comma-separated suggestion types. Allowed values: product, collection, query

### `thebodyshop_sitemap_urls`

- **HTTP:** `GET /thebodyshop/sitemap/urls`
- **What:** List The Body Shop sitemap URLs. Returns capped URL entries from The Body Shop's (https://www.thebodyshop.com) child sitemaps matching the requested type. The storefront URL is fixed server-side.
- **Params:** `limit` (integer, optional) — Maximum URL entries, defaults to 50 and supports up to 250; `type` (string, optional) — Sitemap type. Allowed values: all, products, collections, pages, blogs, agentic_discovery, other

### `thebodyshop_sitemaps`

- **HTTP:** `GET /thebodyshop/sitemaps`
- **What:** List The Body Shop sitemaps. Returns child sitemap URLs from The Body Shop's (https://www.thebodyshop.com) `/sitemap.xml` index with inferred sitemap types. The storefront URL is fixed server-side.
- **Params:** _none_

### `thebodyshop_store`

- **HTTP:** `GET /thebodyshop/store`
- **What:** Get The Body Shop store metadata. Returns storefront metadata for The Body Shop (https://www.thebodyshop.com). The storefront URL is fixed server-side, so no `url` parameter is accepted.
- **Params:** _none_

### `thedailybeast_article`

The response has the title, description, section, authors, publication and update times, lead image URL, body `paragraphs` and a `paywalled` flag. Digest or index pages are not articles and return an error.

### `thedailybeast_author`

- **HTTP:** `GET /thedailybeast/author`
- **What:** Get a The Daily Beast author profile. Returns one The Daily Beast reporter's public profile: name, job title, biography, headshot, social link, and their recent articles, from a canonical author URL.

### `thedailybeast_headlines`

- **HTTP:** `GET /thedailybeast/headlines`
- **What:** Get The Daily Beast section headlines. Returns the current headlines of one The Daily Beast section. `section` is required and takes a slug such as `politics`, `politics/opinion`, `obsessed/reviews`, `scouted/home` or `world/china`. Each item can carry its title, URL, summary, author, publication time, lead image and `type`, and the response echoes the `section`.

### `thedailybeast_news`

- **HTTP:** `GET /thedailybeast/news`
- **What:** Get The Daily Beast top stories. Returns the current top stories from The Daily Beast. It takes no parameters. Each item has its title, URL, summary, publication time, author and lead image, so it is a quick front-page view; use the headlines endpoint with a `section` slug for one category.

### `thedailybeast_sections`

- **HTTP:** `GET /thedailybeast/sections`
- **What:** Get The Daily Beast sections. Lists the sections of The Daily Beast that the headlines endpoint accepts, both top-level categories such as `politics` and `world` and child sub-sections such as `politics/opinion` and `world/middle-east`. Each entry has a `slug`, a display `name` and the section `url`.
- **Params:** _none_

### `dailycaller_article`

- **HTTP:** `GET /dailycaller/article`
- **What:** Get The Daily Caller article content. Returns public The Daily Caller article metadata and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL. Patriots-only (premium) articles expose only a public teaser and are flagged paywalled.

### `dailycaller_author`

- **HTTP:** `GET /dailycaller/author`

### `dailycaller_news`

- **HTTP:** `GET /dailycaller/news`
- **What:** Get The Daily Caller top stories. Returns about 25 of the newest Daily Caller top stories, mixed across sections. Each item has its title, URL, author, publication time (RFC 3339, UTC) and lead image. It takes no parameters; use the headlines endpoint when you want a single section.

### `denverpost_headlines`

Items carry title and URL, plus summary, author, publication time and image when the card shows them. Cards without a dated Denver Post article URL are skipped.

### `denverpost_news`

- **HTTP:** `GET /denverpost/news`
- **What:** Get Denver Post top stories. Returns the article cards on the Denver Post homepage, about 91 when last checked, though the count varies as the site updates. Each item has a title and URL and can carry a summary, author, publication time, image and `type`. It takes no parameters.

### `denverpost_sections`

- **HTTP:** `GET /denverpost/sections`
- **What:** Get Denver Post section and topic inventory. Lists the Denver Post slugs that the headlines endpoint accepts: 56 editorial sections and 19 topic archives, checked on 2026-09-30. Examples are `colorado`, `denver-broncos`, `economy` and `hiking`. Each entry has a `slug`, `name` and `url`. Branded content and cartoons are left out.
- **Params:** _none_

### `expresstribune_author`

- **What:** Get an Express Tribune author's public archive. Returns one page of story cards from a canonical public author archive. Page is 1-based; the publisher's Next link indicates another page.

### `expresstribune_headlines`

### `expresstribune_news`

- **HTTP:** `GET /expresstribune/news`
- **What:** Get The Express Tribune top stories. Returns current top stories from The Express Tribune's public RSS feed. Feed dates and publisher teasers are returned as published.
- **Params:** _none_

### `expresstribune_sections`

- **HTTP:** `GET /expresstribune/sections`
- **What:** Get The Express Tribune sections. Returns every usable feed section listed in the publisher's RSS directory. talko is omitted because its official endpoint currently returns an empty response.
- **Params:** _none_

### `thehill_article`

- **HTTP:** `GET /thehill/article`
- **What:** Get The Hill article content. Returns one The Hill article by `url`, which must be a canonical HTTPS `thehill.com` article link containing a numeric article id. The response has the title, description, section, authors, publication and update times, lead image URL, body `paragraphs` and a `paywalled` flag.

- **What:** Get The Hill top stories. Returns the current top stories from The Hill. It takes no parameters. Each item has its title, URL and, where the outlet gives them, a summary, author, publication time, image URL and `type`. Use the headlines endpoint to read one section instead.

### `thehill_sections`

- **HTTP:** `GET /thehill/sections`
- **What:** Get The Hill RSS sections. Lists the 19 The Hill section slugs that the headlines endpoint accepts, such as `home`, `policy`, `senate`, `defense` and `technology`. Each entry has the section `slug`, its display `name` and its `url`.

## The RealReal (11)

### `therealreal_autocomplete`

- **HTTP:** `GET /therealreal/autocomplete`
- **What:** Get The RealReal search-box suggestions. Returns The RealReal's own search-box typeahead suggestions for a partial query.
- **Params:** `term` (string, **required**) — Partial free-text query to get search-box suggestions for

### `therealreal_categories`

- **HTTP:** `GET /therealreal/categories`
- **What:** Get The RealReal category browse taxonomy. Returns The RealReal's full category (taxon) browse taxonomy: every department, category, and subcategory, nested, with each entry's id (usable directly against search's category_id), permalink (usable directly against the category endpoint's path), and live matching item count. This is reference data that changes rarely, so responses are cached.
- **Params:** _none_

### `therealreal_category`

- **HTTP:** `GET /therealreal/category`
- **What:** Browse The RealReal listings by category. Returns a page of The RealReal listings browsed by category (taxon) permalink path, e.g. women/handbags. Pass a previous response's next_after back as after to fetch the next page.
- **Params:** `after` (string, optional) — Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's next_after. Omit for the first page; `available` (boolean, optional) — Only return items currently available to purchase (excludes sold and waitlisted items); `on_sale` (boolean, optional) — Only return items currently marked down from their original price; `path` (string, **required**) — Category permalink path, from the categories endpoint's permalink field

### `therealreal_collection`

- **HTTP:** `GET /therealreal/collection`
- **What:** Browse The RealReal listings by curated collection. Returns a page of The RealReal listings browsed by curated collection slug, e.g. on-sale-now -- sale campaigns, editor's picks, and similar merchandising collections distinct from category/designer browsing. Pass a previous response's next_after back as after to fetch the next page.
- **Params:** `after` (string, optional) — Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's next_after. Omit for the first page; `slug` (string, **required**) — Collection slug, from the collections endpoint's slug field

### `therealreal_collections`

- **HTTP:** `GET /therealreal/collections`
- **What:** Get The RealReal curated collection slugs. Returns The RealReal's full published set of curated editorial and sale-campaign collection slugs (e.g. on-sale-now, hermes-birkin-bag), each usable directly against the collection endpoint's own slug field. This is reference data that changes rarely, so responses are cached.
- **Params:** _none_

### `therealreal_conditions`

- **HTTP:** `GET /therealreal/conditions`
- **What:** Get The RealReal condition-grading value space. Returns The RealReal's full authentication condition-grading scale: the closed 6-tier set (Pristine, Excellent, Very Good, Good, Fair, As Is) it defines, each with an id (usable directly against search's condition_id) and live matching item count. This is reference data that changes rarely, so responses are cached.
- **Params:** _none_

### `therealreal_designer`

- **HTTP:** `GET /therealreal/designer`
- **What:** Browse The RealReal listings by designer. Returns a page of The RealReal listings browsed by designer slug, e.g. gucci. Pass a previous response's next_after back as after to fetch the next page.
- **Params:** `after` (string, optional) — Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's next_after. Omit for the first page; `available` (boolean, optional) — Only return items currently available to purchase (excludes sold and waitlisted items); `on_sale` (boolean, optional) — Only return items currently marked down from their original price; `slug` (string, **required**) — Designer slug, from the designers endpoint's slug field

### `therealreal_designers`

- **HTTP:** `GET /therealreal/designers`
- **What:** Get The RealReal designer directory. Returns every designer The RealReal recognizes in one department (not just designers with currently active listings), each with an id (usable directly against search's designer_id) and slug (usable directly against the designer endpoint). The directory is segmented by department -- pass category to select one; the response's categories field lists every accepted value. This is reference data that changes rarely, so responses are cached.
- **Params:** `category` (string, optional) — Designer-directory department. One of: women, men, fine-jewelry, watches, art, home, kids. Defaults to women

### `therealreal_listing`

- **HTTP:** `GET /therealreal/listing`
- **What:** Get a The RealReal listing detail. Returns a single The RealReal listing: description, condition detail, category context, and measurements, plus the shared summary fields (name, designer, condition, price, images). Looked up by the listing's full product URL, as returned in a search/category/designer response's url field.
- **Params:** `url` (string, **required**) — Full product URL, as returned in a search/category/designer response's url field

### `therealreal_search`

- **HTTP:** `GET /therealreal/search`
- **What:** Search The RealReal luxury consignment listings. Searches The RealReal's authenticated luxury resale catalog by keyword, optionally combined with category, designer, condition-grade, and price-range filters, returning listing summaries (name, designer, condition, price, images) plus the total matching count and an opaque pagination cursor. Pass a previous response's next_after back as after to fetch the next page.
- **Params:** `after` (string, optional) — Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's next_after. Omit for the first page; `available` (boolean, optional) — Only return items currently available to purchase (excludes sold and waitlisted items); `category_id` (string, optional) — Category (taxon) id, from the categories endpoint's id field; `condition_id` (string, optional) — Condition grade id, from the conditions endpoint's id field; `designer_id` (string, optional) — Designer id, from the designers endpoint's id field; `on_sale` (boolean, optional) — Only return items currently marked down from their original price; `price_from` (number, optional) — Minimum price in USD; `price_to` (number, optional) — Maximum price in USD; `query` (string, **required**) — Free-text keyword search

### `therealreal_similar`

- **HTTP:** `GET /therealreal/similar`
- **What:** Get The RealReal similar-item recommendations. Returns The RealReal's own "Similar Items" visual-similarity recommendations for one product, looked up by the product's numeric id (from any other The RealReal endpoint's listing response id field).
- **Params:** `product_id` (string, **required**) — The RealReal numeric product id, from a search/category/designer/listing/collection response's id field

Examples are `news-latest`, `latest-nation`, `business-smebiz` and `sport-football`. Each entry has a `slug`, a `name` and the section page `url`.
- **Params:** _none_

## The Sydney Morning Herald (5)

### `smh_article`

- **HTTP:** `GET /smh/article`
- **What:** Get The Sydney Morning Herald article content. Returns one Sydney Morning Herald article's public metadata and the body paragraphs an anonymous visitor's page request is served, from a canonical article URL. The Sydney Morning Herald runs a metered subscription paywall; the response reports it with is_accessible_for_free (the page's own declaration), paywalled (the page marks the story as subscriber content), and is_truncated (the page served a shortened preview, or no body at all, instead of the full story). Paywalls are never bypassed and body text is never fabricated. Video-only pages are rejected with a 400.
- **Params:** `url` (string, **required**) — Canonical The Sydney Morning Herald article URL

### `smh_author`

- **HTTP:** `GET /smh/author`
- **What:** Get a Sydney Morning Herald journalist profile. Returns a Sydney Morning Herald journalist's public profile -- name, short biography, headshot, contact email and social links where published -- plus their recent stories, from a canonical https://www.smh.com.au/by/<name>-<id> URL.
- **Params:** `url` (string, **required**) — Canonical The Sydney Morning Herald journalist URL

### `smh_headlines`

- **HTTP:** `GET /smh/headlines`
- **What:** Get The Sydney Morning Herald section headlines. Returns the current stories for one Sydney Morning Herald section: title, canonical URL, summary, author, publication time, and image where the section lists them. section must be one of the slugs returned by /smh/sections; any other value is rejected with a 400 before The Sydney Morning Herald is contacted.
- **Params:** `section` (string, **required**) — Section slug from /smh/sections

### `smh_news`

- **HTTP:** `GET /smh/news`
- **What:** Get The Sydney Morning Herald top stories. Returns The Sydney Morning Herald's current "Latest News" public RSS feed: each story's title, canonical URL, summary, author, publication time, and lead image.
- **Params:** _none_

### `smh_sections`

- **HTTP:** `GET /smh/sections`
- **What:** Get The Sydney Morning Herald sections. Lists every Sydney Morning Herald section accepted by /smh/headlines (96 sections from the site's own section menu), each with its slug, display name, and public section-front URL.
- **Params:** _none_

## Threads (10)

### `threads_post`

- **HTTP:** `GET /threads/post/{username}/{code}`
- **What:** Retrieve a public Threads post. Returns one public Threads post by `username` (with or without a leading `@`) and the post `code` from its URL. The response has the post text, canonical URL, preview image URL, and the author's id, name and username. Replies and logged-in fields are not included. An unavailable post returns 404.
- **Params:** `code` (string, **required**) — Threads post code; `username` (string, **required**) — Threads username

### `threads_post_replies`

- **HTTP:** `GET /threads/post/{username}/{code}/replies`
- **What:** Retrieve public replies to a Threads post. Returns the public replies currently exposed to logged-out visitors. The response identifies when Threads reports additional replies but withholds a usable continuation cursor.
- **Params:** `code` (string, **required**) — Threads post code; `username` (string, **required**) — Threads username

### `threads_profile`

- **HTTP:** `GET /threads/profile/{username}`
- **What:** Retrieve a public Threads profile. Returns a public Threads profile by `username` (with or without a leading `@`): name, profile URL, biography, avatar URL, `followers_count` and `threads_count`. Counts are derived from the compact figures shown on the profile page. An unavailable profile returns 404.
- **Params:** `username` (string, **required**) — Threads username

### `threads_profile_media`

- **HTTP:** `GET /threads/profile/{username}/media`
- **What:** Retrieve public media posts from a Threads profile. Returns the first public page shown on a profile's Media tab. Items include image and video URLs, including carousel attachments, plus post and topic metadata. The logged-out page exposes no continuation cursor or media-type filter; `pagination_limited` reports when additional results are gated by login or lack a supported cursor.
- **Params:** `username` (string, **required**) — Threads username

### `threads_profile_posts`

- **HTTP:** `GET /threads/profile/{username}/posts`
- **What:** Retrieve public posts from a Threads profile. Lists public posts from the profile's Threads tab by `username`. Each item has its code, URL, text, creation time, image and video URLs, like, reply, repost and quote counts, reply flag and author. When `has_more` is true, pass `next_cursor` unchanged as `cursor` to fetch the next page; `pagination_limited` is true if Threads withholds a usable cursor.
- **Params:** `cursor` (string, optional) — Opaque cursor returned by the previous response; `username` (string, **required**) — Threads username

### `threads_profile_replies`

- **HTTP:** `GET /threads/profile/{username}/replies`
- **What:** Retrieve public items from a Threads profile's Replies tab. Returns the first public page shown on a profile's Replies tab. Each item preserves its actual author and public reply metadata. The logged-out page has no continuation cursor; `pagination_limited` is true when Threads reports more items without a cursor or shows a login wall for additional items.
- **Params:** `username` (string, **required**) — Threads username

### `threads_profile_reposts`

- **HTTP:** `GET /threads/profile/{username}/reposts`
- **What:** Retrieve public posts reposted by a Threads profile. Returns the first public page shown on a profile's Reposts tab. Each item preserves the original post author and metadata. `pagination_limited` is true when Threads gates more items behind login or reports more items without a supported cursor.
- **Params:** `username` (string, **required**) — Threads username

### `threads_profile_topics`

- **HTTP:** `GET /threads/profile/{username}/topics`
- **What:** Discover public topic tags on a Threads profile. Returns every topic tag listed on a public profile, including the numeric tag id and canonical `name` to pass as `q` to `/threads/search/topics`. Community topics include their community metadata.
- **Params:** `username` (string, **required**) — Threads username

### `threads_search`

- **HTTP:** `GET /threads/search`
- **What:** Search public Threads posts. Returns the public first page of Threads search results for a query. `sort` supports `top` and `recent`; `pagination_limited` marks the logged-out login wall because search has no continuation cursor. Author and date filters in Threads require login and are not exposed here.
- **Params:** `q` (string, **required**) — Search query (1-100 characters); `sort` (string, optional) — Result order; defaults to top

### `threads_topic_search`

- **HTTP:** `GET /threads/search/topics`
- **What:** Search posts for a public Threads topic tag. Returns the public first page of posts for a topic tag. Discover the required `tag_id` and its canonical query `name` from `/threads/profile/{username}/topics` or a post's `topic` metadata. Topic results have no logged-out continuation cursor; `pagination_limited` marks the login wall for more results.
- **Params:** `q` (string, **required**) — Canonical topic query from a profile topic's `name` or a post topic's `search_query`; `tag_id` (string, **required**) — Numeric Threads topic tag id

## Ticketmaster (15)

### `ticketmaster_attraction`

- **HTTP:** `GET /ticketmaster/attraction`
- **What:** Get a Ticketmaster attraction. Returns one Ticketmaster attraction (artist, team or other event entity) by numeric `id`: name, synopsis, image, URL, classification (segment, genre, sub-genre) and `has_artist_video`. Past performance `setlists` and `setlist_source_url` appear only when available. An unknown attraction returns 404.
- **Params:** `id` (string, **required**) — Numeric Ticketmaster attraction id

### `ticketmaster_attraction_events`

- **HTTP:** `GET /ticketmaster/attraction-events`
- **What:** List an attraction's Ticketmaster events. Lists upcoming Ticketmaster events for the attraction with numeric `id`. `page` is zero-based, 0 to 49, default 0; `sort` is `relevance` or `date` (default). Each event has title, start time, time zone, venue, attractions, presales, seat map and status flags such as `sold_out` and `cancelled`. The response gives `total`.
- **Params:** `id` (string, **required**) — Numeric Ticketmaster attraction id; `page` (integer, optional) — Zero-based page (0-49); `sort` (string, optional) — Result order

### `ticketmaster_attraction_related`

- **HTTP:** `GET /ticketmaster/attraction-related`
- **What:** List a Ticketmaster attraction's related attractions. Returns the "Fans Also Viewed" attractions shown on one attraction's own page. An attraction with no recommendation data returns a valid empty list.
- **Params:** `id` (string, **required**) — Numeric Ticketmaster attraction id

### `ticketmaster_attraction_reviews`

- **HTTP:** `GET /ticketmaster/attraction-reviews`
- **What:** List a Ticketmaster attraction's fan reviews. Lists fan reviews for the Ticketmaster attraction with numeric `id`, with its `average_rating`, `best_rating`, `total` and Ticketmaster's own `ai_review_summary`. Each review has a rating, title, text, nickname, city, venue and date. `offset` runs 0 to 9995 (default 0); `limit` runs 10 to 50 (default 10).
- **Params:** `id` (string, **required**) — Numeric Ticketmaster attraction id; `limit` (integer, optional) — Reviews per page (10-50); `offset` (integer, optional) — Result offset (0-9995)

### `ticketmaster_discover_categories`

- **HTTP:** `GET /ticketmaster/discover-categories`
- **What:** List Ticketmaster discover categories. Lists every current Concerts, Sports, Arts & Theater, and Family category with pagination. Section accepts `all`, `concerts`, `sports`, `arts-theater`, and `family`.
- **Params:** `page` (integer, optional) — One-based page; `per_page` (integer, optional) — Categories per page; `section` (string, optional) — Discover section

### `ticketmaster_discover_category_events`

- **HTTP:** `GET /ticketmaster/discover-category-events`
- **What:** List events in a Ticketmaster discover category. Lists events in a Ticketmaster discover category, identified by `category_id` from `ticketmaster-discover-categories`. `page` is zero-based, 0 to 49. Each event has title, start time, time zone, venue, attractions, presales, seat map and status flags such as `sold_out` and `cancelled`. The response gives `total` and `count`.
- **Params:** `category_id` (string, **required**) — Ticketmaster discover category id; `page` (integer, optional) — Zero-based page

### `ticketmaster_discover_cities`

- **HTTP:** `GET /ticketmaster/discover-cities`
- **What:** List Ticketmaster discover cities. Lists Ticketmaster's discover city destinations for a `country` (two-letter code, default `US`). Each city has a `slug`, name, canonical URL, locale and image. `page` starts at 1 and `per_page` runs 1 to 100. The response gives `total`. Pass a city `slug` to `ticketmaster-discover-city-events`.
- **Params:** `country` (string, optional) — Two-letter country code; `page` (integer, optional) — One-based page; `per_page` (integer, optional) — Cities per page

### `ticketmaster_discover_city_events`

- **HTTP:** `GET /ticketmaster/discover-city-events`
- **What:** List events in a Ticketmaster discover city. Lists events for a Ticketmaster discover city, identified by `city` (a slug from `ticketmaster-discover-cities`) and `country` (two-letter code matching the city, default `US`). It covers all municipalities grouped under that destination. `page` is zero-based, 0 to 49. Each event has title, start time, venue, attractions and status flags.
- **Params:** `city` (string, **required**) — Ticketmaster discover city slug; `country` (string, optional) — Two-letter country code matching the selected city; `page` (integer, optional) — Zero-based page

### `ticketmaster_event`

- **HTTP:** `GET /ticketmaster/event`
- **What:** Get a Ticketmaster event. Returns one Ticketmaster event by `id`: title, description, start time, time zone, currency, venue, attractions, classification, presales, on-sale time, seat map URL, and flags for sold out, cancelled, postponed, rescheduled and virtual. An unknown event returns 404; a concluded or removed event returns 410.
- **Params:** `id` (string, **required**) — Ticketmaster event id

### `ticketmaster_search_events`

- **HTTP:** `GET /ticketmaster/search-events`
- **What:** Search Ticketmaster events. Searches Ticketmaster events by artist, event, team, or venue. A zero total with an empty events list is a valid no-results response. The sort enum accepts `relevance` and `date`.
- **Params:** `page` (integer, optional) — Zero-based page (0-49); `q` (string, **required**) — Artist, event, team, or venue query; `sort` (string, optional) — Result order

### `ticketmaster_suggest`

- **HTTP:** `GET /ticketmaster/suggest`
- **What:** Suggest Ticketmaster artists, events, and venues. Returns autocomplete suggestions for a partial artist, event, team or venue name in `q`. Each suggestion has a title, `type`, category, URL, image and, when available, an `event_count`. The response also gives the echoed `query` and the `count` of suggestions.
- **Params:** `q` (string, **required**) — Partial artist, event, team, or venue query

### `ticketmaster_trending_attractions`

- **HTTP:** `GET /ticketmaster/trending-attractions`
- **What:** List trending Ticketmaster attractions. Returns a ranked list of currently-trending attractions across every segment (music, sports, arts and theater, family), not scoped to one category or city.
- **Params:** _none_

### `ticketmaster_venue`

- **HTTP:** `GET /ticketmaster/venue`
- **What:** Get a Ticketmaster venue. Returns one Ticketmaster venue by numeric `id`: name, address, city, state, country, postal code, coordinates, time zone, image, URL and visitor information as name and text entries. `seat_maps` and `city_categories` are omitted when none exist. An unknown venue returns 404.
- **Params:** `id` (string, **required**) — Numeric Ticketmaster venue id

### `ticketmaster_venue_enhanced_details`

- **HTTP:** `GET /ticketmaster/venue-enhanced-details`
- **What:** Get a Ticketmaster venue's enhanced branding details. Returns header branding imagery and external links (the venue's own site, resident teams) for major venues. Smaller venues without enhanced content return 404.
- **Params:** `id` (string, **required**) — Numeric Ticketmaster venue id

### `ticketmaster_venue_events`

- **HTTP:** `GET /ticketmaster/venue-events`
- **What:** List a venue's Ticketmaster events. Lists upcoming Ticketmaster events at the venue with numeric `id`. `page` is zero-based, 0 to 49, default 0; `sort` is `relevance` or `date` (default). Each event has title, start time, time zone, attractions, presales, seat map and status flags such as `sold_out` and `cancelled`. The response gives `total`.
- **Params:** `id` (string, **required**) — Numeric Ticketmaster venue id; `page` (integer, optional) — Zero-based page (0-49); `sort` (string, optional) — Result order

## TicketWeb (3)

### `ticketweb_event`

- **HTTP:** `GET /ticketweb/event`
- **What:** Get a TicketWeb event. Returns details for one TicketWeb event: venue, dates, age restriction, delivery methods, and per-tier ticket pricing (base price, fee breakdown, and total) when tickets are on sale. `has_tickets` is false and `sections` is empty for a free/RSVP event with no paid tickets, a sold-out event, or an access-code-gated event -- TicketWeb's own data does not reliably distinguish these three cases at this level, so the response reports the shared observable state (no purchasable sections) rather than guessing which applies.
- **Params:** `id` (string, **required**) — Numeric TicketWeb event id

### `ticketweb_search`

- **HTTP:** `GET /ticketweb/search`
- **What:** Search TicketWeb events. Searches TicketWeb events by artist, event, or venue. A zero count with an empty events list is a valid no-results response. availability is one of `in_stock`, `sold_out`, `unknown` per event.
- **Params:** `page` (integer, optional) — One-based result page, 1-50; `q` (string, **required**) — Artist, event, or venue query

### `ticketweb_venue`

- **HTTP:** `GET /ticketweb/venue`
- **What:** Get a TicketWeb venue. Returns one TicketWeb venue's detail (name, address) plus one page of its upcoming events. A zero count with an empty events list on page 1 is a valid "no upcoming events" response.
- **Params:** `id` (string, **required**) — Numeric TicketWeb venue id; `page` (integer, optional) — One-based page of upcoming events, 1-50

## Tiffany & Co. (8)

### `tiffany_categories`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiffany/categories`
- **What:** List Tiffany & Co. categories. Lists every category id Tiffany & Co.'s own product catalog accepts, each with a human-readable label, a kind (category for a real navigable department/subcategory, curated_shop for a curated gift/merchandising shelf), and a live product count. Each id is exactly what tiffany-category's own category parameter accepts -- resolves the category-discovery gap that parameter would otherwise leave as "find one from a storefront URL".
- **Params:** _none_

### `tiffany_category`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiffany/category`
- **What:** Browse a Tiffany & Co. category. Returns one page of a Tiffany & Co. category/browse listing. category is a category id from tiffany-categories's own id field (e.g. ecommerce_us_jewelry_necklaces_and_pendants). sort selects recommended (default), price_asc, price_desc, or newest. material, gemstone, color, product_type, gender, and designer are optional single-value filters -- see tiffany-filters for the live covered value space for each. A hub-level or emptied-out category id, or a filter combination with no matches, returns a well-formed empty result rather than an error.
- **Params:** `category` (string, **required**) — Category id -- see tiffany-categories; `color` (string, optional) — Color filter -- see tiffany-filters; `designer` (string, optional) — Designer/collection filter -- see tiffany-filters; `gemstone` (string, optional) — Gemstone filter -- see tiffany-filters; `gender` (string, optional) — Gender filter -- see tiffany-filters; `material` (string, optional) — Material filter -- see tiffany-filters; `page` (integer, optional) — One-based page; `per_page` (integer, optional) — Results per page; `product_type` (string, optional) — Product type filter -- see tiffany-filters; `sort` (string, optional) — Sort order

### `tiffany_content_search`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiffany/content-search`
- **What:** Search Tiffany & Co. editorial content. Searches Tiffany & Co.'s own editorial pages -- style guides, gift guides, and other "World of Tiffany" articles -- by free-text keyword. Not product data: no price, stock, or item id fields. A genuine non-matching keyword returns a well-formed empty result (zero total_results).
- **Params:** `keyword` (string, **required**) — Search keyword; `page` (integer, optional) — One-based page; `per_page` (integer, optional) — Results per page

### `tiffany_filters`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiffany/filters`
- **What:** List Tiffany & Co. search/category filter values. Lists every value tiffany-search's and tiffany-category's material, gemstone, color, product_type, gender, and designer filter parameters accept, each with a live product count -- resolves the discovery gap those parameters would otherwise leave as "find one on the live site's own filter sidebar".
- **Params:** _none_

### `tiffany_product`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiffany/product`
- **What:** Get a Tiffany & Co. product. Returns full product detail for one item: name, description, brand, collection, designer, material, gemstone, USD price, live stock status, category tree, every color/style variation, and images. product_id is Tiffany & Co.'s own item id, as returned by tiffany-search's or tiffany-category's own products[].id field.
- **Params:** `product_id` (string, **required**) — Item id, from a search or category result's id field

### `tiffany_search`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiffany/search`
- **What:** Search Tiffany & Co. products. Searches Tiffany & Co.'s product catalog by free-text keyword. Returns product summaries with USD pricing, live stock status, material, gemstone, collection, and designer. sort selects recommended (default), price_asc, price_desc, or newest. material, gemstone, color, product_type, gender, and designer are optional single-value filters -- see tiffany-filters for the live covered value space for each. A genuine non-matching keyword, or a filter combination with no matches, returns a well-formed empty result (zero total_products).
- **Params:** `color` (string, optional) — Color filter -- see tiffany-filters; `designer` (string, optional) — Designer/collection filter -- see tiffany-filters; `gemstone` (string, optional) — Gemstone filter -- see tiffany-filters; `gender` (string, optional) — Gender filter -- see tiffany-filters; `keyword` (string, **required**) — Search keyword; `material` (string, optional) — Material filter -- see tiffany-filters; `page` (integer, optional) — One-based page; `per_page` (integer, optional) — Results per page; `product_type` (string, optional) — Product type filter -- see tiffany-filters; `sort` (string, optional) — Sort order

### `tiffany_stores`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiffany/stores`
- **What:** Find Tiffany & Co. store locations. Finds Tiffany & Co. physical stores, boutiques, and cafes near a coordinate, ordered by distance. Each result includes address, phone, opening hours, in-store services and specialities, and live open/closed status.
- **Params:** `latitude` (number, **required**) — Latitude, -90 to 90; `limit` (integer, optional) — Maximum stores to return; `longitude` (number, **required**) — Longitude, -180 to 180; `radius` (number, optional) — Search radius in miles

### `tiffany_suggest`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiffany/suggest`
- **What:** Get Tiffany & Co. search-box suggestions. Returns Tiffany & Co.'s own search-box suggestions (typeahead) for a partial query -- a flat list of suggested search phrases, each with its own live total result count on the product catalog. Not product data.
- **Params:** `query` (string, **required**) — Partial search query

## TikTok (45)

### `tiktok_category`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/category`
- **What:** List TikTok explore categories. Returns the content categories shown on TikTok's Explore page. Each entry has the category name and its numeric type code. Takes no parameters.
- **Params:** _none_

### `tiktok_challenge`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/hashtag/{name}`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok hashtag details. Returns the details of a TikTok hashtag page by `name`, for example `christmas`. The response carries `challengeInfo` with the hashtag's metadata, such as cover images, and `shareMeta` with the share title and description. The hashtag id found here feeds `tiktok-challenge-list`.
- **Params:** `name` (string, **required**) — Hashtag name (e.g., 'christmas')

### `tiktok_challenge_list`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/hashtags`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok hashtag posts. Lists the videos posted under a TikTok hashtag, identified by the hashtag `id` from the hashtag detail endpoint. `cursor` defaults to 0. The response has `itemList`, `hasMore` and a `cursor`; pass that cursor back to fetch the next page.
- **Params:** `cursor` (integer, optional) — Pagination cursor; `id` (string, **required**) — Hashtag id returned by the hashtag detail endpoint

### `tiktok_comments`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/comments`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok video comments. Returns the top-level comments on a TikTok video, by the video id from its URL (`aweme_id`). Results are paged by cursor: pass the `cursor` from one response to get the next page, and read `has_more` to see whether more remain. The response also carries the total comment count.
- **Params:** `aweme_id` (string, **required**) — TikTok video id from the video URL; `cursor` (integer, optional) — Pagination cursor

### `tiktok_creative_center_filters`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/creative-center/filters`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok Creative Center filter taxonomy. Returns the complete filter taxonomy for the Creative Center trend endpoints: the countries each trend tab reports, the industry ids and video content tags the filters accept, the supported lookback periods, and the video sort metrics. Use it to discover valid values for the hashtags endpoint's country_code, period, and industry_id parameters and the videos endpoint's country_code, period, sort_by, and content_label_ids parameters. This endpoint performs no upstream request and has no parameters.
- **Params:** _none_

### `tiktok_creative_center_hashtags`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/creative-center/hashtags`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok Creative Center trending hashtags. Returns TikTok Creative Center's ranked trending hashtags for a country, period, and optional industry. TikTok gates this endpoint's full result set behind a logged-in TikTok One account: an anonymous request always receives at most 3 hashtags per filter combination regardless of country, period, or industry, so selecting an industry returns that industry's own ranked top three. See the filters endpoint for the complete country, period, and industry value lists.
- **Params:** `country_code` (string, **required**) — ISO-2 country code; `industry_id` (string, optional) — Creative Center industry id to restrict the ranking to; `period` (integer, optional) — Lookback window in days

### `tiktok_creative_center_top_content`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/creative-center/top-content`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok Creative Center top content. Returns TikTok Creative Center's current Top Content set: four top-performing branded videos, each with the video object (anonymous MP4 and cover URLs), engagement metrics, the author profile and follower count, and (by default) the video's top comments plus keyword mention counts derived from them. The set is a daily snapshot and there is no pagination or historical query; the four titles rotate when the snapshot changes. Set include_comments=false for a smaller response with only video, author, and metrics.
- **Params:** `include_comments` (boolean, optional) — Include each object's top comments and comment-keyword counts

### `tiktok_creative_center_videos`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/creative-center/videos`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok Creative Center trending videos. Returns TikTok Creative Center's ranked trending videos for a country, period, sort order, and optional content tags. TikTok reports the true result-set size (see total_count/page_count in the response) but gates access to it behind a logged-in TikTok One account: an anonymous request always receives page 1 (4 videos) regardless of sort order or period. Country coverage is uneven: only US, JP, ID, VN, and TH have a regional edge host that returns populated results; other countries return an empty videos array (a genuine no-data response, not an error). See the filters endpoint for the complete country, period, sort, and content tag value lists.
- **Params:** `content_label_id` (string, optional) — Deprecated: single content tag id; use content_label_ids instead; `content_label_ids` (array, optional) — Content tag ids to filter by, repeatable; matches videos carrying any selected tag; `country_code` (string, **required**) — ISO-2 country code; `organic_only` (boolean, optional) — Restrict to organic (non-paid) videos only; `period` (integer, optional) — Lookback window in days; `sort_by` (string, optional) — Sort order

### `tiktok_explore`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/explore/{id}`
- **What:** Retrieve the TikTok explore feed for a category. Returns the TikTok explore feed for a category, given its category type `id` from the category endpoint. The response has `itemList` with the videos, `hasMore` and a `cursor`. A feed that comes back empty is reported as an upstream error, not as an empty list.
- **Params:** `id` (integer, **required**) — Category type id returned by the category endpoint

### `tiktok_mobile_feed`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/mobile/feed`
- **What:** Retrieve the TikTok mobile For You feed. Returns one page of videos from TikTok's mobile For You feed, signed with well-formed mobile signature headers (no device or account needed). Each item carries `aweme_id`, `create_time`, `author_id`, `share_url` and the verified statistics block (`play_count`, `digg_count`, `comment_count`, `share_count`, `collect_count`, `download_count`, `forward_count`, `lose_count`, `lose_comment_count`, `whatsapp_share_count`, `repost_count`). A zero `count` uses the app's default page size; `count` is capped at 50.
- **Params:** `count` (integer, optional) — Videos to request (0 = app default, max 50); `cursor` (integer, optional) — Pagination cursor

### `tiktok_mobile_hashtag`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/mobile/hashtag`
- **What:** Retrieve a TikTok hashtag. Returns one hashtag's detail by name: `challenge_info` (cid, hashtag_name, desc, ...) and `stats` (view and video counts), exactly as the mobile API returns them. Hashtags are addressed by name; an internal id is rejected upstream.
- **Params:** `name` (string, **required**) — Hashtag name without the leading #

### `tiktok_mobile_hashtag_posts`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/mobile/hashtag/posts`
- **What:** Retrieve videos for a TikTok hashtag. Lists videos for one hashtag name as the mobile app returns them (`aweme_list` with author, music and statistics), plus `cursor` and `has_more`. `sort=fresh` is the newest list and works from any measured egress; `sort=popular` is the hot list and only answers from a US egress.
- **Params:** `count` (integer, optional) — Videos per page (max 50); `cursor` (integer, optional) — Pagination cursor; `name` (string, **required**) — Hashtag name without the leading #; `sort` (string, optional) — Listing: fresh (newest) or popular (hot)

### `tiktok_mobile_hashtags`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/mobile/hashtags`
- **What:** Search TikTok hashtags. Searches hashtags by keyword and returns the matching hashtag objects unmodified, with `cursor` and `has_more` for paging.
- **Params:** `count` (integer, optional) — Results per page (max 50); `cursor` (integer, optional) — Pagination cursor; `keyword` (string, **required**) — Keyword to search hashtags for

### `tiktok_mobile_live_effects`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/mobile/live/effects`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok LIVE effects. Returns the complete LIVE effects/sticker asset catalogue in one call: `data.assets` (2,032 assets, each with `id`, `name`, `describe`, `resource_url`, `resource_uri`, `md5`, `size`, `resource_type`, `download_type`, `model_requirements`, `sticker_asset_variant` and `video_resource_list`). There are no request parameters and no paging, and the body is large because the catalogue is complete.
- **Params:** _none_

### `tiktok_mobile_live_gifts`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/mobile/live/gifts`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok LIVE gifts. Returns the complete LIVE gift catalogue in one call: `data.gifts` (771 gift objects with `diamond_count`, `describe`, `duration`, `gift_resources`, `gift_skins`, `batch_gift_info` and `combo`) plus the gift config and resource maps (`gift_configs`, `gifts_info`, `doodle_templates`, `gift_name_group_map`, `gift_resource_group_map`). There are no request parameters and no paging: the response is a single complete catalogue.
- **Params:** _none_

### `tiktok_mobile_live_search`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/mobile/live/search`
- **What:** Search TikTok LIVE streams. Searches the mobile app's LIVE surface by keyword: `data` of `{type, anchor}` entries with `feedback_type` set to `live`, plus `cursor` and `has_more`. `keyword` is required; without it the gateway answers a valid but empty envelope. This is the API's first LIVE endpoint.
- **Params:** `count` (integer, optional) — Results to request (0 = app default, max 50); `keyword` (string, **required**) — Search keyword

### `tiktok_mobile_music_beats`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/mobile/music/beats`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok music beats. Returns the mobile app's beats/songs chart unmodified: `music_list` of the same full sound objects the pick chart returns (`id_str`, `title`, `user_count`, `album`, `artists`, `cover_*`), ordered as the app's beats list. The measured envelope carries no paging fields.
- **Params:** `count` (integer, optional) — Accepted for compatibility; not measured to change the page (max 50)

### `tiktok_mobile_music_collections`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/mobile/music/collections`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok music collections. Returns the mobile app's sound-collection feed unmodified: `mcf_list`, where each entry is `{collection, music_list}` (the measured default page holds 8 entries), plus `cursor` and `has_more`. This route is first-page only: the returned `cursor` is not a reusable page token, so callers should not page with it.
- **Params:** `count` (integer, optional) — Collections to request (0 = app default, max 50); `cursor` (integer, optional) — Accepted for shape compatibility only; not a verified page token

### `tiktok_mobile_music_pick`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/mobile/music/pick`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok sound chart picks. Returns the mobile app's sound pick/chart list: `music_list` of full sound objects (id, title, author, user_count, duration, ...) plus the chart list `mc_list` and `radio_cursor`.
- **Params:** `count` (integer, optional) — Sounds per page (max 50); `cursor` (integer, optional) — Pagination cursor

### `tiktok_mobile_music_posts`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/mobile/music/posts`
- **What:** Retrieve videos for a TikTok sound. Lists the videos that use one sound, as the mobile app returns them: `aweme_list` of full video objects (with `author`, `statistics` and `added_sound_music_info`), plus `cursor` and `has_more`. `music_id` is required. `count` is accepted but ignored upstream - the server returns its own default page, so page with `cursor`.
- **Params:** `count` (integer, optional) — Accepted for compatibility; the server ignores it (max 50); `cursor` (integer, optional) — Pagination cursor; `music_id` (string, **required**) — Sound (music) id

### `tiktok_mobile_music_related`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/mobile/music/related`
- **What:** Retrieve sounds related to a TikTok video. Returns sounds related to one video: `music_list` of full sound objects, `recall_info_list` explaining why each was recalled, `similar_song_ids`, plus `cursor` and `has_more`.
- **Params:** `aweme_id` (string, **required**) — Video id to find related sounds for; `count` (integer, optional) — Sounds per page (max 50); `cursor` (integer, optional) — Pagination cursor

### `tiktok_mobile_music_trending`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/mobile/music/trending`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok trending sounds. Returns the mobile app's trending sound chart: `music_list` of full sound objects (`id_str`, `title`, `user_count`, `album`, `artists`, `cover_large`/`cover_medium`/`cover_thumb`, `binded_challenge_id`, `collect_stat`, `audition_duration`) unmodified, plus `cursor` and `has_more` for paging. This is the chart behind `music.trending`.
- **Params:** `count` (integer, optional) — Sounds per page (max 50); `cursor` (integer, optional) — Pagination cursor

### `tiktok_mobile_search`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/mobile/search`
- **What:** Search TikTok videos on the mobile API. Keyword search returning the mobile API result documents unmodified: each entry has `aweme_info` (a full video object with statistics), `card_profile` and search metadata, plus `cursor` and `has_more`. Keep `count` small (20 already exceeds one megabyte of upstream JSON).
- **Params:** `count` (integer, optional) — Results per page (max 20); `keyword` (string, **required**) — Search keyword; `offset` (integer, optional) — Result offset

### `tiktok_mobile_search_music`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/mobile/search/music`
- **What:** Search TikTok sounds on the mobile API. Keyword search over sounds, returning `music_info_list` of full sound objects unmodified with `cursor`, `has_more` and `total`.
- **Params:** `count` (integer, optional) — Sounds per page (max 50); `keyword` (string, **required**) — Search keyword; `offset` (integer, optional) — Result offset

### `tiktok_mobile_search_user`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/mobile/search/user`
- **What:** Search TikTok users on the mobile API. Keyword search over users, returning `user_list` unmodified. Each `user_info` carries the populated creator statistics (follower_count, following_count, total_favorited, aweme_count, custom_verify).
- **Params:** `count` (integer, optional) — Users per page (max 50); `cursor` (integer, optional) — Pagination cursor; `keyword` (string, **required**) — Search keyword (a username or display name)

### `tiktok_mobile_trending_categories`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/mobile/trending/categories`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok trending categories. Returns the discover-category feed unmodified: each `category_list` entry is `{aweme_list, category_type, challenge_info, click_track_url_list, desc, track_url_list}`, with `cursor` and `has_more` for paging.
- **Params:** `count` (integer, optional) — Categories per page (max 50); `cursor` (integer, optional) — Pagination cursor

### `tiktok_mobile_trending_effects`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/mobile/trending/effects`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok trending effects. Returns the effect/sticker discovery feed unmodified: `aweme_list` of full video objects, each additionally carrying `stickers` and `sticker_detail`, plus `feed_session_id`, `cursor` and `has_more`.
- **Params:** `count` (integer, optional) — Videos per page (max 50); `cursor` (integer, optional) — Pagination cursor

### `tiktok_popular_trend_country_industry_meta`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/popular-trend/country-industry-meta`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok popular-trend country and industry metadata. Lists the country and industry filter values used by the TikTok Creative Center popular-trend endpoints. Countries have an `id` such as `AR` and a name; industries have a numeric `id` and a name such as Apparel & Accessories. A maintained fallback list is returned if TikTok's own metadata is unavailable.
- **Params:** _none_

### `tiktok_post`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/post/{id}`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok video details. Returns TikTok's detail record for one video by video id. `itemInfo.itemStruct` holds the video's description, the author's profile and the author's statistics (such as followers, following and hearts) along with the rest of TikTok's video object; `shareMeta` holds the share title and description.
- **Params:** `id` (string, **required**) — TikTok video id

### `tiktok_posts`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/posts`
- **What:** Retrieve posts from a TikTok profile. Lists posts from a TikTok profile identified by `secUid`. `sort_type` is `0` latest (default), `1` popular or `2` oldest. `cursor` defaults to 0. The response has `itemList`, `hasMore` and a `cursor` to pass back to fetch the next page.
- **Params:** `cursor` (integer, optional) — Pagination cursor; `secUid` (string, **required**) — TikTok secUid for the profile; `sort_type` (integer, optional) — Sort mode: 0 latest, 1 popular, 2 oldest

### `tiktok_profile`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/profile/{handler}`
- **What:** Retrieve a TikTok profile. Returns a public TikTok profile by `handler`, the username without the leading `@`. The `user` object has the id, `uniqueId`, nickname, signature, verified and private flags, region, language, avatar, bio link and `secUid`; `stats` has follower, following, heart, video and friend counts. A missing, deleted or banned handle returns 404.
- **Params:** `handler` (string, **required**) — TikTok handle without the leading @

### `tiktok_search`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/search`
- **What:** Search TikTok videos. Searches TikTok videos for `keyword`. `cursor` defaults to 0 and `count` defaults to 20, capped at 50. The response has the matching video items, a `cursor` and `has_more` for paging. An empty, blocked or malformed result from TikTok returns an upstream error.
- **Params:** `count` (integer, optional) — Result count, clamped to 50; `cursor` (integer, optional) — Pagination cursor; `keyword` (string, **required**) — Search keyword

### `tiktok_search_hashtag`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/search/hashtag`
- **What:** Search TikTok hashtags. Searches TikTok hashtags (challenges) for `keyword`. `cursor` defaults to 0 and `count` defaults to 20, capped at 50. The response has `challenge_list` with each hashtag's name and id, plus a `cursor` and `has_more` for paging. An empty, blocked or malformed result returns an upstream error.
- **Params:** `count` (integer, optional) — Result count, clamped to 50; `cursor` (integer, optional) — Pagination cursor; `keyword` (string, **required**) — Search keyword

### `tiktok_search_user`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/search/user`
- **What:** Search TikTok users. Searches TikTok users for `keyword`, with `cursor` (default 0) for paging. The response has `user_list` with the matching accounts, plus a `cursor` and `has_more` to continue. Pass the returned `cursor` back to fetch the next page.
- **Params:** `cursor` (integer, optional) — Pagination cursor; `keyword` (string, **required**) — Search keyword

### `tiktok_top_ads_analysis`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/top-ads/analysis`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok Top Ads interactive time analysis. Returns the detail-page interactive time analysis chart and percentile for a Top Ads material. Metric values are `retain_ctr` (CTR), `retain_cvr` (CVR), `click_cnt` (Clicks), `convert_cnt` (Conversion), and `play_retain_cnt` (Remain).
- **Params:** `material_id` (string, **required**) — Top Ads material id; `metric` (string, optional) — Interactive time analysis metric; `period_type` (integer, optional) — Percentile lookback period in days

### `tiktok_top_ads_detail`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/top-ads/detail`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok Top Ads detail. Returns detail for one TikTok Creative Center Top Ads material. Use `material_id`; the upstream does not accept `id` or `materialId`.
- **Params:** `material_id` (string, **required**) — Top Ads material id

### `tiktok_top_ads_filters`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/top-ads/filters`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok Top Ads filters. Returns filter metadata for TikTok Creative Center Top Ads. Dynamic values come from TikTok; static UI enums are included for `order_by`, `duration`, `like`, and `ad_format`.
- **Params:** _none_

### `tiktok_top_ads_list`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/top-ads/list`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok Top Ads. Returns high-performing auction ads from TikTok Creative Center. The service defaults `period` to 30, `page` to 1, `limit` to 20, and `order_by` to `for_you`. Use `/tiktok/top-ads/filters` for dynamic enum values and static enums for order, duration, likes, and ad format.
- **Params:** `ad_format` (string, optional) — Ad format id; `ad_language` (string, optional) — Ad language id or comma-separated ids from /tiktok/top-ads/filters; `country_code` (string, optional) — Country code or comma-separated country codes from /tiktok/top-ads/filters; `duration` (string, optional) — Video duration bucket; `industry` (string, optional) — Industry filter id or comma-separated ids from /tiktok/top-ads/filters; `keyword` (string, optional) — Brand or product keyword search; `like` (string, optional) — Like percentile bucket id or comma-separated ids; `limit` (integer, optional) — Maximum number of ads to return; `objective` (string, optional) — Objective filter id or comma-separated ids from /tiktok/top-ads/filters; `order_by` (string, optional) — Sort order; `page` (integer, optional) — Page number; `pattern_label` (string, optional) — Pattern label id or comma-separated ids from /tiktok/top-ads/filters; `period` (integer, optional) — Lookback period in days

### `tiktok_top_ads_location_info`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/top-ads/location-info`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok Top Ads location info. Returns TikTok's inferred initial country and industry targeting context for Top Ads. Use it when you need starting targeting values; use the locations, filters, and list endpoints to choose criteria and retrieve ads.
- **Params:** `module` (integer, optional) — Optional upstream Creative Center module identifier; omitted or 0 defaults to 1, other nonzero IDs are passed through without local range validation

### `tiktok_top_ads_locations`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/top-ads/locations`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok Top Ads locations. Lists the country filters offered by TikTok Creative Center Top Ads. Each country has an `id` such as `US`, a `value` (the country name), a `label` and a `has_conversion` flag. Takes no parameters.
- **Params:** _none_

### `tiktok_top_ads_recommend`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/top-ads/recommend`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok Top Ads recommendations. Lists Top Ads materials that TikTok Creative Center recommends as related to the ad with `material_id`. `page` starts at 1; `limit` defaults to 20 and is capped at 100. Each ad has its title, brand, likes, comments, shares, CTR, objectives and video info. The list can be empty for a valid id.
- **Params:** `limit` (integer, optional) — Maximum number of ads to return; `material_id` (string, **required**) — Top Ads material id; `page` (integer, optional) — Page number

### `tiktok_top_ads_safety`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/top-ads/safety`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok Top Ads safety configuration. Returns the Creative Center safety configuration flags for search: `top_ads_search`, `keyword_search`, `hashtag_search`, `creator_search`, `sound_search` and `cc_banner_key`. It carries feature flags only, not ad materials. Takes no parameters.
- **Params:** _none_

### `tiktok_top_ads_spotlight`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/top-ads/spotlight`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok Top Ads Spotlight. Lists the Top Ads Spotlight materials that TikTok Creative Center hand-picks. `page` starts at 1; `limit` defaults to 20 and is capped at 100. Each ad has its title, brand, likes, comments, shares, CTR, objectives and video info. `data.pagination` gives the page, size, total and `has_more`.
- **Params:** `limit` (integer, optional) — Maximum number of ads to return; `page` (integer, optional) — Page number

### `tiktok_top_ads_suggestions`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/top-ads/suggestions`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok Top Ads suggestions. Returns Top Ads search suggestions from TikTok Creative Center. `count` is the maximum number of suggestions (default 50) and `scenario` picks the suggestion scenario id (default 1). The `query` list can be empty for the default scenario.
- **Params:** `count` (integer, optional) — Maximum number of suggestions to return; `scenario` (integer, optional) — Suggestion scenario id

### `tiktok_trending`

- **HTTP:** `GET /tiktok/trending`
- **What:** Retrieve TikTok trending posts. Returns the current TikTok trending feed: `itemList` holds the videos, and `hasMore` and `cursor` describe paging. The response also has a `trendingTopics` field. Takes no parameters.
- **Params:** _none_

## TIME (5)

### `time_article`

- **HTTP:** `GET /time/article`
- **What:** Get TIME article content. Returns one TIME article by `url`, which must be a canonical HTTPS dated `time.com` article link. The response has the title, description, section, authors, publication and update times, lead image URL, body `paragraphs` and a `paywalled` flag.
- **Params:** `url` (string, **required**) — Canonical TIME article URL

### `time_author`

- **HTTP:** `GET /time/author`
- **What:** Get a TIME author profile.
